lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank, with the highest-intensity centroids located in the region posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a structured rectilinear grid where blobs reside at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity upper edges and dark shadowed recesses immediately below the ridge lines.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of high-luminance blobs is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, showing lower density and smaller diameter compared to the primary lateral flank blobs.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits exhibits a transition from a grid-based pattern to a high-density stochastic field of significantly smaller, high-luminance pixel clusters.
